headline: ‘Loaded with potential’: stage version of TV smash It’s a Sin has the dancefloor at its heart

members.title: ‘Loaded with potential’: stage version of TV smash It’s a Sin has the dancefloor at its heart
members.lead: Exclusive: Trailer released for Rambert’s version of Russell T Davies’s show about friendship amid the 80s Aids crisis and the ‘extraordinary freedom’ of clubbing Russell T Davies’s award-winning series It’s a Sin, about young gay friends living through the Aids crisis in 1980s London, is getting a new life as a dance piece, with a trailer released on Monday ahead of an opening at Aviva Studios in Manchester in February. “We had a few approaches, but a lot of people wanted to make it a musical, which made my heart sink slightly,” said Davies. “I always imagined an aria between those two women on the seafront at the end and I thought: ‘Oh, that could be so terrible!’” Dance was different, he said. “It felt so original and so pure. The story distils down to these emotional moments that are going to be done so beautifully on stage.” Continue reading...

members.title: Elon Musk joins 158,000 others calling for Nvidia to bring back Jensen Huang in open letter
members.lead: Silicon Valley figures back CEO ousted after revelations of affair with suspected Chinese spy, as US treasury secretary urges Nvidia to carry out ‘dramatic shake-up’ Elon Musk and a host of other tech executives are among more than 158,000 signatories of an open letter calling for Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as Nvidia chief, days after he resigned from the multi-trillion dollar chip company. The letter demands that the company’s board members “bring Jensen back while an independent investigation establishes the facts”. Continue reading...
